name: Affinity Bancshares, Inc. Common Stock (MD)
description: Affinity Bancshares Inc is a bank holding company. The bank provides a range of financial services, including checking and savings accounts, certificates of deposit, mortgage, commercial and consumer loans, and money transfer services, operating across parts of Georgia and offering specialized lending such as dental practice and indirect automobile loans across the Southeastern United States. Its business mainly involves accepting public deposits and investing them in real estate and commercial loans, as well as mortgage-backed securities. The company also gathers deposits nationwide through its virtual bank, FitnessBank, and uses additional funding sources such as Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings.
